name: haiku-compact
description: Squish your context with Haiku when the prompt cache goes cold, so your main model re-caches a short summary instead of the whole transcript. A live band shows the cache warming down, going cold and getting squished.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Model that writes the summary, and the word after /compact that selects it (alias or full id).

keepMessages.title: Messages kept verbatim
keepMessages.description: How many recent messages to keep word for word after the summary.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt-cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long your prompt cache stays warm: 60 or 5. The band counts down from it.

minTokens.title: Minimum context tokens
minTokens.description: Smaller contexts are left alone: no band, no compaction.

autoCompactOnResume.title: Compact on a cold resume
autoCompactOnResume.description: Resuming a session whose cache has gone cold squishes it with the summary model at once.

holdPromptWhenCold.title: Hold the first prompt when cold
holdPromptWhenCold.description: Hold your first prompt after the cache went cold and offer /compact haiku first; sending it again skips that.
